tools.name: search_drugs
tools.description:
Search the drug boards by free text and by field.

`query` also matches the other indications a molecule is pursuing, from the indications matrix
(MASH, CKD, sleep apnea, heart failure, CV outcomes, type 2 diabetes, and their trial names),
so "MASH" finds every cardiometabolic drug with a MASH progr

tools.name: get_drug
tools.description:
Full record for one drug, with its efficacy figures estimand-tagged and its page URL.

Matching goes slug, then exact name or brand, then substring, so "wegovy", "Wegovy HD" and
"semaglutide-obesity" all land somewhere sensible without the caller knowing the slug scheme.

tools.name: get_trial
tools.description: One trial's design, by NCT number or by trial key (SURMOUNT-1, scale, redefine-1).

tools.name: compare_efficacy
tools.description:
The extracted weight-loss table for the named drugs, joined to trial design, one row per arm and timepoint.

Rows are NOT collapsed to one number per drug. The corpus holds several doses, timepoints and
estimands per trial, and picking a single winner per drug would mean choosing between them
here,

tools.name: get_adverse_events
tools.description:
Extracted adverse-event rates for a named drug or trial, by arm, with the arithmetic that was checked.

`drug` is a molecule or a brand (tirzepatide or Zepbound). `ae_type` narrows to a kind of event,
every word of it found in the stored type: discontinuation_ae is the share who stopped the drug
bec

tools.name: get_trajectory
tools.description:
The digitised weight-loss curve for a drug: week-by-week points, plus per-dose series.

Returned with `endpoint_pct` and its estimand alongside the curve, because the endpoint marker
and the last plotted point are different quantities and the curve alone does not say which one
a reader is looking at

tools.name: list_catalysts
tools.description:
Upcoming and recent readouts, approvals and trial starts across sponsors, oldest first.

For what comes next, pass from_date as today and pending_only=true, and kind="readout" for trial results;
an event whose outcome is set has already happened.

from_date and to_date take YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY

tools.name: list_news
tools.description:
The latest news the site's hubs print, newest first, with date, headline, source and page.

Use it for "what is new" and "latest announcement" questions. It holds the eight newest items
of each hub: obesity, Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly. `company` matches the hub (Novo Nordisk,
Eli Lilly) or the drug'

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "compare_efficacy" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_drug · Private data: get_drug · Public sink: get_adverse_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_drug · Private data: get_drug · Public sink: get_adverse_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
